summary: Keep pointer arithmetic in a single supported unsafe operation.
When C.use accepts a data pointer, pass the backing buffer instead of the Go slice header.
Construct IPv4 and IPv6 host-port pairs with net.JoinHostPort.
When test-file analysis is enabled, fail a test from the goroutine that runs the test.
Use the original slice when appending without additional elements.
Match formatting verbs to their argument types.
Place operations before a terminating return.
Increment the wait group before starting its goroutine.
bad: go func() { group.Add(1); defer group.Done(); work() }()
good:
group.Add(1)
go func() { defer group.Done(); work() }()

summary: Keep shifts within the operand's integer width.
Use the result returned by a pure function.
Pass a mutex by pointer.
bad: func update(mutex sync.Mutex) { mutex.Lock(); defer mutex.Unlock() }

summary: Evaluate deferred measurements when the deferred function runs.
Place go:debug directives before the package declaration in package main or a test file.
Assert only interfaces with compatible method signatures.
When test-file analysis is enabled, use valid Go test function names.
Assign a different value instead of assigning a variable to itself.
Avoid assigning an atomic operation's result back with a non-atomic store.
Call the cancel function returned by context.WithCancel.
good:
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
defer cancel()
use(ctx)

summary: Use standard method signatures for standard interfaces.
good: func (value Item) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { return []byte("{}"), nil }

summary: Use APIs available in the module's declared Go version; slices.Concat requires Go 1.22.
Use strconv to format integers as decimal strings.
Pass a pointer to a decoding destination.
Use Boolean conditions that can become true.
good: if count == 1 { return }; if count == 2 { return }

summary: Use valid build constraint syntax.
Check request errors before using the HTTP response.
Provide a value for each structured log key.
Use valid struct tag syntax.
Preserve the frame pointer in amd64 assembly.
bad:
// work_amd64.s:
TEXT ·Work(SB),NOSPLIT,$0-0
    MOVQ AX, BP
    RET
good:
// work_amd64.s:
TEXT ·Work(SB),NOSPLIT,$0-0
    MOVQ AX, BX
    RET

summary: Apply replacements marked with the go:fix inline directive.
Call declared functions without comparing them to nil.
bad:
func callback() {}
func run() { if callback == nil { return }; callback() }

summary: Buffer channels passed to signal.Notify.
Use 01 for the month and 02 for the day in time layouts.
Pass a pointer to a concrete error type to errors.As.
Match assembly argument sizes to the Go declaration on amd64.
Use keyed literals for structs from another package.
